releaseNotes: v8.10.23: Explicit button-controlled novel update and delta translation workflow. In Library, choose between 'Stage New Chapters (+N)' to translate new chapters while preserving all existing translations, or 'Fetch & Download Raw EPUB (+N)' with dedicated packaging progress bar and zero AI token usage. In Translator, explicit 'Translate Only New Chapters (Ch X–Y)' button prevents re-translation, and post-translation export cards provide 1-tap download and reader opening.
